workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: One NaN model price disables the shared cost budget for later priced turns
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(prices): refuse a run when a price is not a finite number. Target files: src/hmz/cli/output.py, src/hmz/coganchor/agents/allowance.py, src/hmz/coganchor/prices.py. A non-finite model price (`NaN`, `±Infinity`, or a number too large to be finite, e.g. `1e400`) from a malformed upstream snapshot or `HUMANIZE_PRICES` file poisoned the epic's shared cost accounting and silently disabled hard cost limits. Per the maintainer's decision, a bad price now **refuses work** instead of guessing. (Ref: https://github.com/humanfia/humanize/pull/498)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: TUI repeatedly crashes with MarkupError when rendering task status containing $secondary
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tui): never let markup in a transcript line crash the screen. Target files: src/hmz/tui/app.py, src/hmz/tui/selecting.py, tests/integration/doubles_tui.py. - The subagent row (details on) was written as `[$secondary]●[/] …` — Textual markup — but the transcript parses Rich markup, where `[$secondary]` is literal text and the `[/]` closes nothing: `MarkupError` on every resize, and on every replay of that transcript afterwards. - Tool rows, reasoning, `/btw` answers, printed backend output and lines said by another front... (Ref: https://github.com/humanfia/humanize/pull/496)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Structured output can silently select the wrong fenced JSON block
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): read every fenced block in structured answers. Target files: pyproject.toml, src/hmz/coganchor/agents/base.py, src/hmz/runtime/flowing/harnessing.py. . A `JSON`-labelled first code block followed by a `json` block currently returns the second value. Both structured-answer readers now read Markdown fenced blocks in document order through the same CommonMark parser. The whole-answer and brace-span fallbacks keep their existing order. (Ref: https://github.com/humanfia/humanize/pull/464)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: let a session hand a long job to the host, so it outlives the session (`hmz job`)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cred): a job a session detached from itself outlives the session. Target files: src/hmz/coganchor/agents/base.py, src/hmz/coganchor/fence/wrap.py, src/hmz/coganchor/linux/ptrace.py. (the part asked for here: detached jobs survive the session; jobs are not stopped at the epic's end). (Ref: https://github.com/humanfia/humanize/pull/477)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: rlar reviewers cannot see text-only actor deliverables
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(flows): let rlar's reviewer read what the actor said. Target files: src/hmz/flows/builtin/rlar/__init__.py, tests/integration/test_core_sdk.py, tests/unit/flows/builtin/test_rlar.py. In `rlar`, each round's reviewer is a fresh session told only `REVIEW_PROMPT + task`; the actor's reply only decided whether there was anything to review. For a task whose deliverable is the answer itself there was nothing a reviewer could read, so every reviewer asked for the answer again, and the actor answered into its own conversation, ... (Ref: https://github.com/humanfia/humanize/pull/290)
